user_prompt:
method correct_bracketing(brackets: string) returns (result: bool)
    requires brackets != null
    ensures result == (CountOpenBrackets(brackets) == CountCloseBrackets(brackets) && NoUnmatchedClosingBrackets(brackets))

    // Helper function to count opening brackets
    method CountOpenBrackets(b: string) returns (count: int)
        requires b != null
        ensures count >= 0
        ensures count == |{ i | 0 <= i < b.Length && b[i] == '(' }|

    // Helper function to count closing brackets
    method CountCloseBrackets(b: string) returns (count: int)
        requires b != null
        ensures count >= 0
        ensures count == |{ i | 0 <= i < b.Length && b[i] == ')' }|

    // Helper function to check for unmatched closing brackets
    method NoUnmatchedClosingBrackets(b: string) returns (isValid: bool)
        requires b != null
        ensures isValid == (forall i :: 0 <= i < b.Length ==> (CountOpenBrackets(b[..i]) >= CountCloseBrackets(b[..i])))
